reports.work_area: Northfield transit shelter, canopy base B-17
reports.work_planned: Set canopy column B-17 after signed bearing-surface acceptance and the issued base layout are available.
reports.work_completed: Column remained on the lifting frame. Crew held at B-17 from 08:00 to 10:00, then reassigned to bolt the handrail in the adjacent bay.
reports.materials_equipment: Canopy column, lifting frame, non-shrink grout, calibrated torque wrench
reports.issue_or_update: The site coordinator verbally advised at 08:10 that the bearing inspection had passed. The installer had no signed bearing release at 10:00. The issued anchor-layout revision was also awaited.
reports.schedule_status: The September 1 column-setting window was deferred. The recorded hold was two hours; no project completion-date effect has been assessed.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: Bearing release BR-B17 requested; layout instruction LI-017
reports.action_required: Provide the signed bearing release and issued layout before setting B-17.
reports.supporting_evidence: Installer daily log records the 08:00-10:00 hold and reassignment.

reports.work_area: Northfield transit shelter, canopy base B-17
reports.work_planned: Close the written bearing release and issue the approved anchor layout.
reports.work_completed: Signed bearing release BR-B17-0902 issued at 09:00 and acknowledged by the steel foreperson at 09:15. Approved anchor layout S-117 revision 7 issued through the document register at 11:00.
reports.materials_equipment: Canopy column, lifting frame, non-shrink grout, calibrated torque wrench
reports.issue_or_update: BR-B17-0902 explicitly accepts the bearing surface for B-17; it does not cover the later anchor-torque witness. Revision 7 replaces revision 6. The register confirms the layout issue to the site coordinator, but no steel-crew receipt acknowledgement is linked.
reports.schedule_status: The bearing-acceptance gate is closed. Column setting is planned for September 3; physical setting is not reported complete today.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: BR-B17-0902; LI-017; S-117 revision 7; transmittal TR-119
reports.action_required: Obtain and link the steel foreperson's receipt acknowledgement for S-117 revision 7.
reports.supporting_evidence: Signed bearing release and foreperson acknowledgement filed. TR-119 records formal layout issue; crew receipt remains unverified.

reports.work_area: Northfield transit shelter, canopy base B-17
reports.work_planned: Set and grout B-17 using S-117 revision 7.
reports.work_completed: Column B-17 set, aligned and base grouted. Physical setting and grouting are complete. Anchor bolts torqued with the calibrated wrench.
reports.materials_equipment: Canopy column, lifting frame, non-shrink grout, calibrated torque wrench
reports.issue_or_update: The engineer attended the anchor-torque witness. The daily log cites TW-B17-0903, but the signed witness acceptance sheet is not available in the shared folder. No test failure is reported.
reports.schedule_status: Physical setting is complete following the earlier two-hour hold. Automatic acceptance of the separate torque record is not claimed.
reports.action_required: Locate the signed torque-witness acceptance sheet and verify its result before closeout.
reports.supporting_evidence: Lifting log records completed setting. Grout placement log filed. TW-B17-0903 is a reference only; its signed result sheet is unavailable.

reports.work_area: Northfield transit shelter, canopy base B-17
reports.work_planned: Check the closeout folder and continue grout protection.
reports.work_completed: Delivery count and material certificates checked and accepted. Column remains protected; no further installation work is outstanding.
reports.materials_equipment: Canopy column, lifting frame, non-shrink grout, calibrated torque wrench
reports.issue_or_update: BR-B17-0902 remains signed and acknowledged. The signed TW-B17-0903 result sheet is still unavailable, so anchor-torque acceptance cannot be verified from the register reference alone. TR-119 remains formally issued, but the steel-crew receipt acknowledgement has not been located.
reports.schedule_status: Grout strength testing is scheduled for September 5 at 10:00 and has not yet occurred. The planned test is not overdue.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: BR-B17-0902; TW-B17-0903; TR-119; grout sample GS-B17
reports.action_required: Maintain grout protection until the required strength result is documented. Obtain the torque-witness result sheet and the steel-crew layout receipt acknowledgement.
reports.responsible_party: Principal Contractor / Test Laboratory / Document Controller
reports.quantity_or_measurement: Three grout cubes retained for the scheduled test.
reports.supporting_evidence: Delivery and material checks accepted. No grout-strength result is available before the scheduled test.
